blocks.text: Cloud computing mein security (hifazat) bari fikr hai. Sensitive (naazuk, jise chhupa kar rakhna zaroori ho) data door ke servers par rakhne se data breach (data chori ho kar bahar nikal jana) aur data loss (data kho jana) jaise khatre paida hote hain.

items: Security Challenges (hifazat ke masail): cloud providers mazboot security measures karte hain, lekin users ko bhi apne data ki hifazat ke qadam uthane chahiye. Data breach, unauthorized access (baghair ijazat pohanch) aur data loss (data kho jana) jaise masail ho sakte hain.

Security Measures (hifazat ke qadam): khatre kam karne ke liye users encryption (data ko code mein badalna), mazboot authentication (pehchan ki jaanch, maslan mazboot password aur two-step verification) istemal karein aur apni security policies ko regularly check karein. Providers aksar data sambhalne aur mehfooz rakhne ke tools bhi dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Cloud mein apna data mehfooz rakhne ke liye user khud kaun se teen qadam utha sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Encryption istemal kare, mazboot authentication (mazboot password, two-step verification) rakhe, aur apni security policies aur settings ko regularly check kare.

items: Khatre: data breach, unauthorized access, data loss.
Hifazat: encryption, mazboot authentication, policies ko check karna; provider ke tools.
